title: Moi faire, she said, Tous les messieurs
html_source: Literally: ‘moi faire’ means me do and' Tous les messieurs' means all the men. Referring back to ‘bonnne à tout faire’. Faire is the verb for make, do, perform. So here she is saying she will perform, do, all the men. The retort ‘Not this Monsieur’, not this man, suggests Stephen is not comfortable with this arrangement, perhaps due to its sexual nature and Stephen’s catholic guilt.
